name: clean-highway-pay
about: A sound ad: a white tractor and van on a prairie highway at dusk, the pay on the kit's green plate below it. Our overlay over the checker's clean-highway photo.

truth.how: nothing planted: the subject is clear, the plate is the kit's green, the headline over the truck

subject_legible.reason: A sharp, well-lit white semi-truck and trailer filling the frame against a vivid sunset sky is instantly identifiable as a tractor-trailer at a glance.

words_match_picture.reason: A pay-per-mile OTR headline sits over a classic OTR tractor-trailer on an open highway, telling exactly one coherent story about the job.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The large bold headline dominates the dark panel, the 'Apply today' button text is clearly secondary, but the button lacks a distinct button shape or border, making it read more like a subheading than a tappable CTA.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dark panel uses the brand's primary #0B3D2E green and white text precisely, though no logo is present and the button has no distinct styled treatment beyond the brand colours.
